title: Changing the location selection reloads the report with hours pooled into one row per technician, never beyond accessible locations
permissions_required: The permission that grants access to the timesheet reports (same as Timesheet Activities - no new permission); user with access to at least two locations.
preconditions: 1. A technician has clocked time at TWO accessible locations in the range.
2. You are on the Technician Utilization report.
steps: 1. Select only location A and read the technician's hours.
2. Add location B to the selection and watch the report.
3. Count the technician's rows and compare the hours against A + B.
4. Expand the technician and check the day rows on a day with time at both locations.
expected: 1. Selecting one, several, or all locations RELOADS the report scoped to that set (unlike the technician filter, which is on-screen only).
2. All metrics (technician rows, per-day rows, and the Summary) reflect only clock records at the selected location(s).
3. The technician's hours are POOLED across the selected locations into ONE row (one row per technician, not one per location); per-day rows pool the same way.
4. Scoping never goes beyond the user's accessible locations - a location the user cannot access is never included.
design_ref: none - SPEC-ONLY (Report Suite: no designs yet; design-reconciliation later if Figma arrives)
notes: HEAVY SEEDING: one technician with clock records at two locations in one window.
